explanation: Frontal lobes lesions(BF3) -> Expressive (Broca's) aphasia: Depression and lack of motivation(bore). Anosmia (blocked nose). Temporal lobe lesion(t4) -> Wernicke's aphasia(talk). Prosopagnosia (difficulty recognizing faces)(thinking of face). Memory problem(time). Perception of auditory impulses(tone). Parietal lobe lesions(fingers related) -> Astereognosis (tactile agnosia)(somesthetic association area). Finger agnosia (difficulty in identifying the fingers and naming them). Agraphia (difficulty in writing). Occipital lobe lesions(ocular) -> Homonymous hemianopia (with macula sparing). Cortical blindness. Visual agnosia.
